chapters.title: Small Sparks
chapters.mood: Rusty tuned percussion, soft plucks and an optimistic mechanical shuffle.

chapters.title: Last Service
chapters.mood: Rail-like ticks, moving bass and clean repeating synth patterns.

chapters.mood: Clockwork counter-rhythms, tuned metal and precise interlocking arpeggios.

chapters.title: Return Receipt
chapters.mood: Bouncy parcel-delivery rhythm, pizzicato-like plucks and relaxed electric keys.

chapters.title: After the Shutters

chapters.title: Assembly in Motion
chapters.mood: Low industrial pulse, resonant machine percussion and economical melodic fragments.

packaging.purpose: Complete consolidated 55-mission development repository; only C01 is currently implemented.
packaging.encodingPolicy: One delivered encoding per cue: MP3 for music/ambience, WAV where supplied for effects/stingers.
packaging.pathBase: All paths are relative to the application/repository root. Resolve against the actual deployment base URL, not the origin root or this JSON file directory.
packaging.runtimeOwner: src/audio/mixer.js is the existing owner. Do not create a second AudioContext/mixer.
packaging.currentlyWiredManifest: src/audio/manifest.js contains the unchanged Chapter 1 subset. This full catalog does not auto-enable the other cues.
packaging.loopNote: Use supplied loop boundaries and synchronized group starts. In-browser decoding/loop behavior still requires validation.
